alt: Two matching thermometers have a low red liquid column against a cool blue background and a high red column against a warm yellow background.
Side-by-side scenes show rain falling onto green grass and snowflakes falling onto snow-covered grass beneath gray clouds.
Three views of the same tree, bench, and park path show sunshine, rainfall with puddles, and wind bending branches and blowing leaves.
A dry desert basin stretches between rocky mountains, with sparse shrubs, cacti, and exposed sandy soil under a mostly clear sky.
Six matching tanks appear in two rows. The top row has low, medium, and high water levels; a downward arrow leads to three equal middle levels below.
Two rows repeat the same seasonal sequence around a park tree: blossoms and new leaves, full green foliage, orange autumn leaves, and bare branches with snow.
A person watches dark clouds through a window. A nearby laptop shows a rain-cloud symbol on a map, and an umbrella rests on the desk.
A river winds through a broad green valley with forests and grassy slopes, bounded by mountain ridges.
Five successive views show a tree increasing in height, trunk thickness, and leafy crown size above a consistent grassy ground line.
Earth is shown against dark space, with white cloud bands over land and oceans and a thin blue glow along its curved edge.
Three views of the same house and garden show sunshine, an overcast sky, and falling rain with a wet path.
The same weather station appears under sunny, rainy, and overcast skies, with its instruments in consistent positions.
Rain falls over a rocky desert with sparse shrubs and cacti. Fresh puddles collect on the ground beneath dark clouds.
Two sunny scenes contrast a dry cactus landscape with a green forest and flowing river.
A family sits in tree shade drinking from reusable water bottles, with hats beside them and a sunny field beyond.
An adult and child in winter coats walk beside a frost-covered field and bare trees. A small breath cloud is visible.
Side-by-side landscapes contrast a dry, sparsely vegetated basin with a dense green forest bordering a river.
A mountain valley has a brightly sunlit grassy slope on the left and a shaded rocky slope on the right, with a river below.
Two sunny scenes show city rooftops and paved streets on the left, and grassy fields and trees on the right.
A tree-trunk cross-section shows rings of varying widths around a central point. A magnifying glass enlarges several rings.
A gloved scientist examines a horizontal cylindrical ice core with visible layers and tiny bubbles at a snowy field station.
A white louvered instrument shelter, a pole-mounted cup anemometer, and an open cylindrical rain collector stand in a grassy field.
A person holding an umbrella and rain jacket looks toward gray clouds. A tablet on the table displays a cloud-and-rain symbol.
A scientist looks at a row of cylindrical samples beside a tree cross-section and a photograph of a weather station.
